parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of records to return in a single request. Valid values: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that marks the start of the query. Leave this parameter empty to start from the beginning.

parameters.name: NodeGroupIds
parameters.description: A list of node group IDs. The number of array elements N can range from 1 to 100.

parameters.name: NodeGroupNames
parameters.description: A list of node group names. The number of array elements N can range from 1 to 100.

parameters.name: NodeGroupStates
parameters.description: The state of the node group. The number of array elements N can range from 1 to 100.

parameters.name: NodeGroupTypes
parameters.description: A list of node group types. The number of array elements N can range from 1 to 100.
